blind.description: A wooden apothecary or merchant counter featuring three inset rectangular panels on the front and back. The left half of the countertop is arranged with herbalist and alchemy supplies: a large wicker-clad demijohn bottle with green glass and cork stopper, four round green glass bottles with cork stoppers, three cream-colored ceramic storage jars with lids, a bundle of dried grey-green herbs, and a grey stone mortar and pestle. The right half of the counter top is empty. All surfaces are solid, stylized, and continuous with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A horizontal rectangular wooden surface with the right side bare wood and the left side covered in circular containers (a large wicker-bound jug, four small green bottles, three ceramic jar lids), a bundle of dried herbs along the front edge, and a stone mortar and pestle.
blind.height_vs_figure: The counter surface is about waist-high (roughly 3 ft tall, just over half the figure's height), with the tallest demijohn bottle reaching around 4 ft; the counter is about 5 ft long.
